title: Trump’s White House Posts Fascist Memes As It Wrecks the Economy
author: Asawin Suebsaeng
content:

Since last weekend, when Donald Trump commenced his latest war, we here at
**Zeteo** have been [noting
to](https://newrepublic.com/article/207322/transcript-trump-blurts-damning-
iran-admission-maga-cracks) ourselves that the United States has now fully
entered the "Drive-By Shooting Era" of US foreign policy.

The Trump-Vance administration's actions around the globe don't feel like
those of a functioning government in a healthy democracy, but rather those of
addled suburban teens playing 'Grand Theft Auto: Vice City,' or "GTA,"
cackling hysterically and chugging gallons of Pepsi as they mow down stretches
of civilians during the video game's many sequences of [drive-by mayhem and
mass murder](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UJsZmAP9Zk0).

Team Trump seems to have spent disturbingly little time considering the
inevitable and disastrous economic consequences that its war on Iran would
bring. Still, we did not necessarily expect the Trump White House would
_actually_ [post](https://x.com/whitehouse/status/2029953667600646655?s=46) a
'Grand Theft Auto' meme to tout the airstrikes being conducted as part of its
illegal, shambolic war on the Islamic Republic, as it did on Friday - just
days after using
[footage](https://x.com/WhiteHouse/status/2029307088808055083?s=20) from the
game 'Call of Duty' in a similar manner. The White House separately posted a
culturally illiterate, fascist war
[meme](https://x.com/WhiteHouse/status/2029741548791853331) using clips from
the films 'Braveheart,' 'Gladiator,' and 'Tropic Thunder,' among others.

The White House is childishly pumping out these excruciatingly unfunny fascist
memes to entertain its far-right staffers and acutely racist YouTubers at a
time when the dead bodies are [piling
up](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/irans-un-envoy-
says-1332-iranian-civilians-killed-war-2026-03-06/) on [all
sides](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/04/iran-war-us-soldiers-
killed-names), and as the financial carnage from Trump's illegal war explodes
- and threatens to plunge the global economy into a full-blown crisis, [in an
election year](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-pollsters-2026-midterms).

None of this should come as a surprise, given how deeply stupid the fashy
MAGAheads in power are, and how desperately they want to be seen as
"[gangster](https://bsky.app/profile/atrupar.com/post/3mfx2hlknqa2a)" and
badass. Yet, even our increasingly feeble president - who
[eagerly](https://apnews.com/article/donald-trump-transcript-state-of-
union-2026-c13e2a07df999b464b733f4a6e84dbd4) touted low gas prices at his
State of the Union address last week - should have understood full well that
attacking Iran was certain to spike oil prices.
